title: Error: requiring unknown module "undefined" when app does not have internet
body:
**Describe the bug 🐛**
When the app is disconnected from any network, trying to import anything from `react-instantsearch/connectors` results in the app crashing with the following error message:

**To Reproduce 🔍**

1. Import anything from `react-instantsearch/connectors`
2. Disconnect device from internet
3. Crash

**Expected behavior 💭**
The app not to crash when using algolia's functions without internet

**Environment:**

* OS: \[e.g. iOS / mac / android]
* Version 4.4.1

Screenshot: http://prntscr.com/jj9arb
